caption: The drawing depicts a single, empty, cylindrical clay flowerpot centered on a plain, lightly textured background. The flowerpot is rendered in naturalistic shades, with the main body of the pot showing a muted yellowish-brown color suggesting terracotta, while the upper rim is distinctly darker and more reddish-brown. The pot is gently shaded to show its curvature and depth, with the inside of the pot drawn in a darker, shadowed tone. There are no additional objects or decorations in the composition, and the flowerpot is the sole focus, with thin, straight lines lightly outlining a rectangular border around it on the page. A signature, "Annie B. Johnston," appears in small, clear script at the bottom right corner of the border.
title: Pottery Flower Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
